basic_details.job_title: MANUU Recruitment 2026 – Walk-in for 7 DEO & MTS Posts
basic_details.post_name: Data Entry Operator (DEO) and Multi Tasking Staff (MTS)

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: Age limits are specified as preferred for each post.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | data entry operator (deo): (i) Graduate from a recognized University / Institute. (ii) Proficiency in DTP. (iii) Proficiency in English & Urdu Typing. (iv) Knowledge of Urdu | multi tasking staff (mts): (i) Secondary School Certificate (X-Standard)/ITI OR its equivalent from a recognized Board/Institute. (ii) Knowledge of Urdu (preferably)

selection_process: Selection is through a Walk-in Interview.
how_to_apply: Download the official notification and registration form from the website.
Fill out the registration form with required details.

Prepare original certificates and one set of self-attested photocopies of educational qualification, proof of age, experience certificate, caste certificate (if applicable), and other relevant documents.
Keep one recent passport-size photograph ready.
Register your name by 9.30 am at the University Guest House on the day of the interview.
Attend the walk-in interview on 13 October 2026 at 10.00 AM at the Committee Room, University Guest House, MANUU Campus, Gachibowli, Hyderabad (TG).
Produce original certificates/documents for verification during the interview.
important_instructions: Candidates must register their names by 9.30 am at the University Guest House on the day of the interview. Candidates reporting after the scheduled registration time will not be entertained. The engagement is purely on a short-term contractual basis initially for 89 days. No TA/DA will be provided to candidates appearing for the Walk-in-Interview. Candidates must satisfy themselves regarding eligibility conditions before appearing. Canvassing in any form shall render the candidate ineligible automatically. Original certificates must be produced for verification at the time of interview. Candidates must provide details of two references with contact numbers and email IDs.

faq.question: Q1. What is MANUU DEO & MTS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by Maulana Azad National Urdu University to engage Data Entry Operators and Multi Tasking Staff on a short-term contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in MANUU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies, including 1 for Data Entry Operator and 6 for Multi Tasking Staff.

faq.question: Q3. When is the MANUU walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 13 October 2026 at 10.00 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the venue for the MANUU walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at the Committee Room, University Guest House, MANUU Campus, Gachibowli, Hyderabad (TG).

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification for Data Entry Operator?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Graduate degree from a recognized University/Institute, proficiency in DTP, proficiency in English & Urdu Typing, and knowledge of Urdu.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification for Multi Tasking Staff?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Secondary School Certificate (X-Standard)/ITI or equivalent from a recognized Board/Institute, with knowledge of Urdu preferably.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly salary for DEO and MTS posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly remuneration is Rs. 25,200/- for Data Entry Operator and Rs. 20,675/- for Multi Tasking Staff.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the reporting time on the interview day?
faq.answer: Candidates must register their names by 9.30 am at the University Guest House on the day of the interview.
